summary: Attach protocol v2 sends replayed and live PTY output over a Unix stream while passing the PTY master descriptor separately for input and terminal control.
transport: Private daemon Unix-domain attachment socket; PTY master transferred with SCM_RIGHTS ancillary data.
framing: Client sends positive shell ID as decimal plus newline. Server sends big-endian u64 replay byte length (or u64::MAX plus one-byte rejection code), then one byte '1' with a PTY descriptor via SCM_RIGHTS, then replay bytes followed by live output until EOF. Control stream is output-only; PTY descriptor is input/resize/query only. Attach protocol v2.

returns.name: replayLength
returns.note: bounded by terminal replay history maximum

returns.name: output
returns.note: replay then live bytes until EOF

fields.name: code
fields.note: 2 shell not open, 3 other, 4 daemon busy

parsing.summary: Server accepts only positive decimal shell IDs terminated by newline within a deadline. Client verifies header, bounded replay length, one-byte marker and exactly supplied descriptor ancillary message.

compatibility: Protocol v2 separates the control output stream from PTY input; deprecated v1 rejection code 1 maps to generic rejection. The terminal-attach helper remains an alternate bridge client.
